name: kbtrainer-electron
description: kbTrainer 2.1 (HTA touch typing trainer) ported to Electron

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.emit.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.models.json && vite build --config vite.config.kblib.mts
scripts.typecheck: npm run tactica && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.domain.json
scripts.smoke: npm run build:smoke && rm -rf /tmp/kbt-smoke && mkdir -p /tmp/kbt-smoke && USE_STRATEGY=1 KBT_SMOKE=/tmp/kbt-smoke xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1920x1280x24" electron .
